coordinates.transform: position_m = position_mm / 1000; preserve original origin and axes
coordinates.reference_pose: Static atlas coordinates; exact volunteer acquisition pose and calibrated joint angles not established. No pose normalization performed.

provenance.origin: Male-volunteer MRI framework plus anatomical reconstruction; distinct from NLM cadavers
provenance.per_part_observed_vs_reconstructed: not supplied; each retained surface is classified reconstructed atlas, never direct observed tissue segmentation

reference_pose.applied_transform: Uniform mm to m scaling only; no translation, rotation, centering or fitted joint pose.

existing_fitted_frame.axis_evidence: Smallest eigenvector of area-weighted articular normal covariance; area-weighted nonlinear radial circle fit with fixed X gauge. No articular surface point is treated as the axis center.
existing_fitted_frame.grip_evidence: Authored 40 mm distal extension beyond the mean distal bone landmarks; no hand mesh.
